entry.summary: Visa-free for business visits up to 90 days.

consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Sarajevo; Australian Embassy, Vienna
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Sarajevo headed by an Honorary Consul. The office provides some consular assistance but can't issue emergency passports or perform notarial acts. Get in contact before you visit.
